correctness.rationale: Over a local chain ring, each primitive nonzero-residue solution splits as J2(0) plus a square-zero scalar trace, by an explicit basis change; the five-variable centralizer calculation yields exact orbit cardinalities. The divisible branch recurses by two levels, giving the closed formula. For geometric jets, the primitive conjugacy parameter space and smooth matrix group give irreducible strata with dimension 4m+floor(m/2). The deep stratum is either an equal-dimensional extra component or specializes from the last primitive stratum. Direct exhaustive checks of matrix equations over F2[t]/t^m, F3[t]/t^m, F5, Z/4, Z/8, Z/9 and centralizer counts agree. Computations do not prove unrestricted claims.
